name: Learn basic active listening
blurb: Listening properly is a set of behaviours — reflecting, summarising, not fixing — and it is the single fastest way to become someone people want to talk to.
gear: Conversations, and the discipline to shut up
steps: Stop preparing your reply while they talk. This is the whole discipline, and it is hard.
Practise reflecting: repeat back the substance in your own words and check you got it right.
Practise summarising at natural breaks: “So the main thing is…”.
Resist the urge to fix. Ask “do you want help thinking it through, or do you want to vent?” before offering solutions.
Get comfortable with silence — count three seconds after they finish before responding.
Notice and name your own hijacking habit: the “that reminds me of when I…” reflex.
tips: Advice given unasked is usually heard as dismissal.
Silence does more work than any question. Most people fill it with the thing they actually meant.
proof: Someone tells you something difficult and afterwards says they felt properly heard.
